description.text: Research direction: Social History of Modern and Recent China, Study of Shanghai City, Study of Regional Social Economy in Recent China and History of Repulic of China

duration.text: The History of Modern and Recent China at Shanghai Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.
